question: Does a changed DA V2 resolution, precision, student, token layout, or attention implementation preserve the canonical FP16 depth and geometry envelope strongly enough to justify a measured device-speed gain?

cohort.selection: the exact four already-consumed TUM windows 000, 016, 020, and 024; no candidate-dependent frame selection

baseline.semantics: 480x640 optical-z metres after the frozen align-corners resize; no per-frame truth fit

depth_metrics.metric_abs_rel: per-frame median abs(candidate-sensor)/sensor over registered sensor pixels in [0.25m,6m]
depth_metrics.scale_aligned_abs_rel: same metric after one per-frame median multiplicative scale; diagnostic of relative structure only and forbidden as deployed scale authority
depth_metrics.aggregation: median and P95 across the 120 fixed frames

geometry_metrics.clearance_error: mean absolute error over known left/center/right clearance pairs
geometry_metrics.false_clear: truth occupied and candidate clear, divided by all known band-by-horizon decisions; conditional rate given truth occupied is also reported
geometry_metrics.geometry_state_change: exact status plus 3 bands by 3 horizons occupancy signature, and whether consecutive-frame change/no-change matches canonical
geometry_metrics.temporal_clearance: MAE of candidate-vs-truth clearance deltas within each sequence and band

performance_gate.metric: same-device fixed-APK end-to-end P95 after candidate quality materialization
performance_gate.rule: a quality-passing candidate with less than 15 percent P95 speedup is not worth model-complexity and maintenance cost

typical_failure_cases.coverage: canonical false-clear clusters, largest clearance errors, largest metric-depth errors, the sensor UNKNOWN/canonical VALID mismatch, and the walking_xyz tail

decision_rules.engineering_gate: all noninferiority gates must pass; no weighted score or compensating failure
decision_rules.standalone_metric_clearance: all absolute consumed task gates must also pass, but this consumed cohort still cannot establish product or safety authority
decision_rules.p2_entry: only quality-materialized candidates that pass engineering noninferiority may consume device profiling budget
decision_rules.final_camera_gate: requires a new session-and-parent-disjoint final-camera cohort with independent RGB-D or ranging truth

forbidden: change roster, frame order, thresholds, bands, horizons, RANSAC, seed, or status semantics after candidate output is opened
fit affine offsets or per-band/per-frame scales using sensor truth
select precision, resolution, student checkpoint, seed, or cadence on this consumed cohort and report the winner as Confirmation
treat canonical parity, teacher agreement, latency, or this consumed result as product or safety authority
